description: This file defines a public enumeration TalkHistoryTimestamp with a static helper method isAfter that checks whether a given timestamp (in seconds or milliseconds) is after a specified reference time, accommodating different timestamp formats common in history logging.

methods.name: isAfter
methods.description: Checks whether a given timestamp (which can be in seconds or milliseconds) is after a reference time (sinceSeconds). Handles the distinction between seconds and milliseconds based on timestamp size.
